sections.label: How it works
sections.heading: A Structured Path to Measurable Results
sections.body: We guide you through a structured, step-by-step process designed to uncover the root of your symptoms and optimize your health with precision and care. Each phase builds on the last to ensure safe, personalized, and measurable results.

sections.heading: What working with us looks like
sections.body: A simple process designed to bring clarity and guide you toward a personalized plan.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.title: Book Free VIP Call
steps.body: Speak with a certified hormone specialist about your symptoms and goals. During this call, we'll help you understand what may be contributing to your symptoms and explain how we partner with our patients to optimize their hormones and overall health.

image.alt: Woman on phone, representing free VIP call for hormone health consultation and personalized care

steps.label: Step 2
steps.title: Complete Health Questionnaire and Lab Work
steps.body: After being onboarded, you will complete your lab work and health questionnaire prior to your initial consultation. This is designed to understand your symptoms, lifestyle, history, and performance goals. If you have recent labs, you can submit those and if they contain all needed tests you will not need new lab work.

image.alt: Patient completing health questionnaire, representing lab work, medical history review, and hormone health evaluation

steps.label: Step 3
steps.title: Meet with a Licensed Medical Provider
steps.body: Meet via phone, video, or in person with your RHM licensed medical provider to review your symptoms, health questionnaire, lab results, and to discuss any and all concerns you may have. Together you will discuss your diagnosis, and we will build a personalized treatment plan specifically for you.

image.alt: Patient meeting with medical provider by video call, representing licensed hormone health consultation and personalized treatment planning

steps.label: Step 4
steps.title: Start your personalized treatment plan
steps.body: Your medications are shipped discreetly to your home. Your RHM team will continue to monitor your progress and notify you when it’s time for refills, labs, and follow up consults. All of this is so that we can together personalize your treatment to achieve your desired goals.

image.alt: Woman receiving treatment at home, representing personalized hormone treatment plan and ongoing wellness care

steps.label: Step 5
steps.title: Ongoing Treatment
steps.body: Your RHM team will communicate when it is time for your follow up labs and consultations. We are also here 24/7 via your patient portal if you have questions or concerns.

image.alt: Doctor holding patient’s hands, representing ongoing hormone treatment, patient support, and follow-up care
